testInstructions: Launch the x64 Debug PowerToys executable produced by the build.
Enable Grab and Move and the Snap windows to screen edges setting, then drag a resizable window to the left and right edges, each corner, and the top edge.
Verify the preview and release result match for half, quarter, and maximize targets, including a background window and a second monitor.
Restore a maximized window and confirm it returns to its release-time position without stealing focus from a newer foreground window.
Disable Snap windows to screen edges and confirm normal Grab and Move behavior remains unchanged.
